messages:
Maria L: Morning — quick async update from overnight: GPU lane usage drifted up, AMS spot evictions popped 3 nodes in eu-west2, and we hit ~78% of surge headroom. TL;DR: I validated autoscaler logs and applied a temp spike cap; we need a quota bump request for G4s in eu-west2 for the upcoming model rollout. What I did yesterday: validated logs, pushed a temporary limiter. Blockers: quota approval. Today: run node-rebalance dry-run and follow up on quota ticket.
Aj R: can you paste the autoscaler log snippet? curious about what triggered the drains.
Maria L: here — last 6 lines from the scaler:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:14Z scaler INFO scale_down: node.eu-west2-07 marked for drain (spot-termination)
2026-03-17T03:13:01Z scaler INFO scale_up: requested +4 G4 nodes (pending quota)
2026-03-17T03:13:20Z scaler WARN high_queue_length: continuous batching backlog > 240s
```

Devon: Confirmed, I saw the same evictions at 03:12-03:15 UTC. Two of the drains were graceful, one NodeLost. Spot churn likely from cloud maintenance in eu-west2. :wave:

Sasha: I created the quota ticket INFRA-781 and added the details + urgency. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-781 — asked for +10 G4s in eu-west2. Added cost owner and product PM.

deploy-bot: Canary for infra/auto-scaler v2.4 completed: 2/2 regions green.

Neil: I can run the rebalance dry-run at 11:00 UTC and then roll the actual rebalance at 11:30 if the quota is approved. Dry-run command I'll run:
```
# dry-run node rebalance
./scripts/rebalance_nodes.sh --region eu-west2 --dry-run --max-move 6
```

Maria L: awesome, @Neil — please post the dry-run output here. Also @Sasha can you ping cloud support channel for an ESTIMATED ETA? We need a decision by noon UTC to proceed with the rollout.

Sasha: pinged support and sent them the eviction logs + expected commit window. They estimated 4-6 hours but asked for confirmation of instance family (G4). I replied with exact SKU list.

Aj R: if quota is delayed, fallback plan: serve smaller models or enable 4-bit quantization for the hottest endpoints. I left a note on the rollout doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/rollouts/model-2026-03

Maria L: thanks — plan for the day: 1) Neil runs dry-run @11:00 UTC and posts results, 2) Sasha chases quota ETA, 3) Aj prepares quantized fallback and update configs. I'll monitor autoscaler alerts and update INFRA-781 with final decision. Will post final status here after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
